description: This file defines the interface for mode control in a network management context, including enums for IP modes, function prototypes for getting IP version and performing mode control actions, and external library includes.

methods.name: get_ipversion
methods.description: Returns the IP version (IPv4 or IPv6) based on the mode control flags.

methods.name: mode_ctrl_action
methods.description: Performs an action (enable/disable) on a specified mode control.
